## Summary (III)

6. String Functions

String provides various library functions to perform different operations on string.

| Functions | Descriptions |
| --- | --- |
| length() | finds the length of a string |
| insert() | inserts characters into an existing string |
| substr() | generates a substring from another string |
| swap() | swaps values of two string variables |

7. Concatenate (Join) Strings

We can join two or more strings using the + operator.

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4int main() {
5
6    string first_name = "Terry";
7    string last_name = "Bogard";
8
9    // join strings using +
10    string full_name = first_name + " " + last_name;
11
12    cout << full_name;
13
14    return 0;
15}
```
